edges.source_location: reflect --if-stale when the git hook just refreshed LESSONS.md
merged result written back to .graphify_extract.json for Step 4
re-clusters, names communities, regenerates the report
must match the AST extractor ID
transcripts added to docs list for Step 3B
video URL transcribed on next run
images extracted by Claude vision on next run
query runs on the merged graph
watch.py named as an existing importer of extract.py
extractors feed the AST half of the extraction

nodes.label: Step B3 - Collect, Cache and Merge Chunks
nodes.rationale: The chunk file existing on disk is the success signal; a missing file means the subagent was likely read-only, so it must warn rather than silently skip, and a failed chunk is skipped without aborting the run.

nodes.label: save_semantic_cache
nodes.rationale: The same SPEC_PATH must be passed as in Step B0 because each cache entry is stamped with the prompt that produced it; a write under a different prompt lands where the next run will not look (#1939).

nodes.label: Part C - Merge AST and Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: AST nodes are kept first and semantic nodes deduplicated by id, so deterministic AST output wins over LLM output on id collisions.

nodes.label: build_from_json
nodes.rationale: root= mirrors the --update runbook (#1361) so source_file is relativized to the same base and the full build never drifts from an incremental update.

nodes.label: Empty Graph Guard
nodes.rationale: Checked immediately after build and before any write so an empty extraction cannot clobber a good graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, or analysis sidecar (#1392).

nodes.label: to_json export with shrink guard
nodes.rationale: Returns False and writes nothing when the new graph is smaller than the existing graph.json (#479); export runs first so the report and sidecar never describe a graph that graph.json does not contain (#1392).

nodes.label: suggest_questions
nodes.rationale: Regenerated in Step 5 with the curated community labels because labels affect question phrasing; Step 4 only produces placeholders.

nodes.label: Step 4 - Build, Cluster, Analyze, Generate Outputs
Step 4.5 - Graph Health Check
nodes.rationale: Read-only and never aborts: it surfaces edge collapse, dangling/missing endpoints, and self-loops, which are the silent-corruption modes of incremental updates and AST/LLM id mismatches; the graph is still usable so the issue is reported rather than fatal.

nodes.label: Step 5 - Label Communities
nodes.rationale: Re-exports graph.json so nodes carry the curated community_name (#2490); the extraction is unchanged from Step 4 so the shrink guard should pass on node count.

nodes.label: Step 6 - Obsidian Vault and HTML Export
nodes.rationale: HTML is generated always but the Obsidian vault is opt-in because it generates one file per node.

nodes.label: Step 9 - Save Manifest, Cost, Cleanup and Report
save_manifest
nodes.rationale: root= relativizes manifest keys to the scan root so the manifest is portable across clones and machines and a later --update matches cached files instead of missing every one (#1417); scan_corpus is the raw full corpus so newly excluded in-root files are dropped rather than masquerading as deletions (#1908).

nodes.label: _stamped_manifest_files
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that actually produced output are stamped, so a detected file whose chunk failed stays unstamped and is re-queued by the next --update instead of being marked done and losing its content forever (#2015); code files are always stamped because AST extraction is deterministic.

nodes.label: Clear Stale semantic_hash for Unstamped Files
nodes.rationale: Files dispatched this run but not stamped still carry a semantic_hash from a prior run, so it is cleared to make detect_incremental re-queue them instead of reading them as unchanged (#1948).

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS instead), never skip the corpus check warning, always show token cost, never hide cohesion behind symbols, and never run HTML visualization above 5,000 nodes without warning.

nodes.label: Interpreter Guard for Subcommands
nodes.rationale: If the user deleted graphify-out/, .graphify_python is missing, so the interpreter that owns the graphify entry point is re-resolved before any subcommand runs.

nodes.label: IS_DIRECTED Substitution
nodes.rationale: True builds a DiGraph preserving edge direction source->target, False the default undirected Graph; the literal placeholder must never be left in the code.

nodes.label: /graphify query Entry Point
nodes.rationale: When graph.json already exists, questions are answered from the graph rather than rebuilding it.

nodes.label: Agent as Graph Guide
nodes.rationale: Only three report sections are pasted and an exploration question is offered so the session feels like navigation rather than a one-shot report; the graph is the map and the agent is the guide.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md graphify Rules
nodes.rationale: Scoped subgraph queries return far less than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep; dirty graphify-out files are expected after hooks and are not a reason to skip graphify.

nodes.label: Antigravity Always-On graphify Rules
nodes.rationale: Offers both CLI and MCP equivalents (query_graph, shortest_path, get_node) so the rule works in either surface.

nodes.label: VS Code Copilot graphify Instructions
nodes.rationale: Lists explicit natural-language triggers so the agent reaches for the graph first, and reserves raw source reading for modifying/debugging code or a stale graph.

nodes.label: graphify query command
nodes.rationale: Answers must use only what the graph contains, quoting source_location, rather than hallucinating edges.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Expansion
nodes.rationale: The matcher is case-folded substring plus IDF with no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language matching, so a wording mismatch returns zero hits and collapses the answer to noise; expansion is constrained to tokens present in the graph's own vocabulary so the agent cannot invent search terms.

nodes.label: BFS Traversal Mode
nodes.rationale: Default mode, best for 'what is X connected to' because it explores nearest neighbors first, layer by layer to depth 3.

nodes.label: DFS Traversal Mode
nodes.rationale: Best for 'how does X reach Y' chain tracing, depth-limited to 6 to avoid traversing the whole graph.

nodes.label: Token-Budget Aware Output
nodes.rationale: Nodes are ranked by term relevance and the output truncated at roughly four characters per token so the subgraph fits the requested budget.

nodes.label: save-result Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Saving the answer back closes the feedback loop: the next --update extracts the Q&A, including the expansion trace, as a node so future queries improve.

nodes.label: Work Memory and reflect --if-stale
nodes.rationale: Outcomes (useful, dead_end, corrected) let future sessions start from preferred sources and skip known dead ends; --if-stale makes the refresh a cheap no-op when LESSONS.md is already newer than every input.

nodes.label: detect_incremental
nodes.rationale: Populates .graphify_detect.json with 'files' as the changed subset and 'all_files' as the full corpus, because later steps read it unconditionally and need both views.

nodes.label: build_merge
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction is always preserved (#801); root= relativizes prune paths to the graph's relative source_file values, and directed= must match --directed or reciprocal edges silently collapse (#1392).

nodes.label: prune_sources
nodes.rationale: Only for genuinely deleted files: changed files are reconciled by build_merge's replace-on-re-extract (#1344), so adding changed files here would delete the freshly re-extracted content.

nodes.label: Code-Only Fast Path
nodes.rationale: When every changed file is code, AST extraction alone suffices and semantic subagents are skipped entirely, so the update costs no LLM tokens.

nodes.label: Rewrite Video Paths to Documents Before Dispatch
nodes.rationale: Changed video files must be transcribed and their transcript paths moved into files['document'] first, otherwise raw .mp4/.mp3 paths are fed to semantic subagents as unreadable media (#1392).

nodes.label: cluster-only Flow
nodes.rationale: Self-contained; Steps 5-9 must not be re-run because they read intermediate files that a prior build's cleanup already deleted, raising FileNotFoundError (#1392).

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction Subagent Prompt
nodes.rationale: Loaded only when at least one chunk holds a doc, paper, or image, since a pure-code corpus skips Part B entirely; passed verbatim with placeholders substituted.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rule
nodes.rationale: IDs use the full repo-relative path so same-named files in different directories stay distinct and match the AST extractor's ID; filename-only or immediate-parent forms create orphan ghost-duplicate nodes, and chunk suffixes would break determinism across chunks.

nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; production showed a bimodal collapse to a binary (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+), so a fixed value set is mandated and unfittable edges are marked AMBIGUOUS instead.

nodes.label: Verbatim source_file Rule
nodes.rationale: Copying the FILE_LIST path character-for-character keeps the full build and incremental --update on the same base, so build_merge's replace-on-re-extract matches the existing node instead of accumulating a duplicate.

nodes.label: Call Edge Direction and Same-Language Constraint
nodes.rationale: Source must be the caller and target the callee, and calls edges must stay within one language because cross-language call edges are phantom artifacts.

nodes.label: semantically_similar_to Edges
nodes.rationale: Reserved for concepts that solve the same problem with no structural link, and only when the similarity is genuinely non-obvious and cross-cutting.

nodes.label: Hyperedge Rule
nodes.rationale: Used sparingly and capped at three per chunk, only when a group relationship of three or more nodes adds information beyond the pairwise edges.

nodes.label: Image Vision Extraction Rules
nodes.rationale: Vision is used to understand what the image IS rather than to OCR it, with per-genre guidance for screenshots, charts, posts, diagrams, figures, and whiteboards.

nodes.label: Rationale as Node Attribute
nodes.rationale: Design intent is stored as a rationale attribute on the relevant concept node rather than as a separate rationale or fragment node, because only named entities and concepts deserve their own node.

nodes.label: transcribe_all
nodes.rationale: The transcript JSON is written from Python rather than a shell redirect because Whisper progress on stdout would corrupt the file (#1392).

nodes.label: Whisper Domain Hint Prompt
nodes.rationale: The agent is already a language model, so it writes the one-sentence domain hint itself from the god node labels instead of making a separate API call; a video-only corpus falls back to a generic punctuation prompt.

nodes.label: Step 2.5 - Transcribe Video and Audio
nodes.rationale: Video and audio cannot be read directly, so transcripts are produced first and then treated as doc files in Step 3; failures warn and continue with the rest.

nodes.label: Wiki Export
nodes.rationale: Must run before Step 9 cleanup so .graphify_labels.json is still on disk.

nodes.label: Neo4j Export and Push
nodes.rationale: Uses MERGE so re-running is safe and does not create duplicates.

nodes.label: FalkorDB Export and Push
nodes.rationale: FalkorDB's GRAPH.QUERY runs one statement at a time with no bulk script import, so pushing is preferred and the Cypher file is only for a portable artifact.

nodes.label: MCP Server (graphify.serve)
nodes.rationale: Exposes query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats and shortest_path over stdio so other agents can query the graph live; Claude Desktop needs the absolute interpreter path because it cannot run command substitution and the system python cannot import graphify under uv tool install.

nodes.label: Token Reduction Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Skipped silently below 5,000 words because for small corpora the graph's value is structural clarity, not token compression.

nodes.label: ingest (/graphify add)
nodes.rationale: URL type is auto-detected (video, tweet, arXiv, PDF, image, webpage) and the --update pipeline is run afterwards to merge the new file into the existing graph.

nodes.label: --watch Background Watcher
nodes.rationale: Debounce waits until file activity stops so a wave of parallel agent writes does not trigger one rebuild per file; code changes rebuild immediately with no LLM, while docs and images only raise a needs_update flag.

nodes.label: graphify clone
nodes.rationale: Clones into ~/.graphify/repos/<owner>/<repo> and reuses existing clones on repeat runs.

nodes.label: graphify merge-graphs
nodes.rationale: The skill pipeline writes everything to graphify-out/ in the current directory, so running it per subfolder would clobber the same output dir; the CLI is used instead because it places graphify-out/ inside each scanned path, and each merged node carries a repo attribute for filtering.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Auto-Rebuild Hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit with no background process and works with any editor; it appends to an existing post-commit hook rather than replacing it, and ignores doc/image changes which need a manual --update.

nodes.label: graphify agents install
nodes.rationale: Writes the graphify section into the local AGENTS.md once per project so the graph is always-on and no manual /graphify is needed in future sessions.

nodes.label: Extractor Migration Playbook
nodes.rationale: extract.py is split one language per PR (upstream #1212) and the playbook is written so an AI agent can execute a whole port in a single session.

nodes.label: Verbatim Move Invariant
nodes.rationale: No renames, reformatting, or improvements are allowed and byte-identity is verified against a saved temp file, because for languages without behavioral tests that byte-identity check is the entire proof of behavior preservation.

nodes.label: One Language Per PR
nodes.rationale: Small diffs keep review trivial and avoid conflicts with other in-flight ports.

nodes.label: Facade Re-export Requirement
nodes.rationale: extract.py must keep exporting every moved name so existing importers (__main__.py, watch.py, pg_introspect.py, tests) do not change.

nodes.label: Strict Import Direction
nodes.rationale: Import direction is strictly extract.py -> extractors/, so a helper still living in extract.py must be classified and moved rather than imported backwards.

nodes.label: Helper Classification (shared vs private)
nodes.rationale: Remaining grep hits after the candidate move decide the destination: still-used helpers are shared and go to base.py, unused ones are private and move into the language module.

nodes.label: _extract_generic Shared Core
nodes.rationale: All config-driven extractors depend on this ~1,300-line core, so it must move first as its own coordinated batch rather than being ported language by language.

nodes.label: Extractor Registry and Registry Test
nodes.rationale: Zero test edits are allowed outside tests/test_extractors_registry.py, because the untouched language tests passing is itself the proof of behavior preservation.
